firm_data.firm_description: Cohen, Soloway & Wooldridge, P.C. concentrates in the critical areas of Trusts and Estates and Elder Law. They guide clients through significant challenges in a practical and supportive way.
notable_facts: The firm was renamed Cohen, Soloway & Wooldridge, P.C. in January 2022.
Kevin H. Cohen served as an assistant adjunct professor at New York University’s Center for Finance, Law and Taxation.
The firm's involvement frequently occurs at a difficult time for their clients.

email.subject: AI for Cohen, Soloway & Wooldridge, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Shari,

I noticed Cohen, Soloway & Wooldridge just marked a year since your January 2022 rebrand. As you've grown the firm's focus on Trusts and Estates and Elder Law work, managing the complexity of these practices with a leaner team is increasingly challenging.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding our regional presence. I'd be happy to stop by White Plains to show how we're helping similar firms compete without sacrificing the practical, supportive approach that matters in your practice areas.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
